faint-text.note: Light: 5.44:1 on the page, 4.79:1 on the stone (explorer sidebar, inline code) — the site's floor at 13px. Dark: 7.09:1.

page.note: NEUTRAL[900] dark, NEUTRAL[0] light; converted from chat-ui's stone/charcoal oklch (hue ~60-75, chroma < 0.016).

panel.note: NEUTRAL[950] dark (darker than the page), NEUTRAL[100] light. Reaches Starlight gray-6/7 and the explorer's sidebar; Starlight's own header and sidebar stay on the page colour (brand.css).

state-running.note: Hex frozen in @felix/design STATE_*; oklch canonical in apps/chat-ui/src/index.css, enforced by check-state-palette.

body.purpose: Prose in Geist Variable, the full 48rem column (~100 characters).

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono Variable; inline code 13px, code blocks at Expressive Code's own size.

wordmark.purpose: Site title; uppercase in CSS so the string stays "Felix".

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starlight LinkButton, primary: the one action a page most wants — "Run it locally" on the home hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.5rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); border-radius:8px; background:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); color:var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816); font:600 .875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Starlight LinkButton, secondary: an ink outline on the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; padding:.5rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); font:600 .875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc) 8%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Caution Callout
components.description: An aside on the state ramp: hairline border at 40% of the hue, 6% flat tint, title in the hue, body in body text. Caution is for things that can hurt a deployment.
components.html:
Caution

FELIX_AUTH_MODE=none is only legal on a loopback bind.
components.css: .ds-callout { --hue:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); padding:1rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 40%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); border-radius:8px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 6%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d2cdc8); font:400 1rem/1.75 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-callout--caution { --hue:var(--felix-state-blocked, #ffd230); } .ds-callout__title { margin:0 0 .5rem; color:var(--hue); font-weight:600; font-size:1.125rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-callout p { margin:0; } .ds-callout code { font:400 .8125rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Note Callout
components.description: A note is information, not a state: the same shape in ink, so hue is left for callouts that need action.
components.css: .ds-note { padding:1rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc) 40%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); border-radius:8px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc) 6%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d2cdc8); font:400 1rem/1.75 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-note__title { margin:0 0 .5rem; color:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); font-weight:600; font-size:1.125rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-note p { margin:0; } .ds-note code { font:400 .8125rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: RunTrace Row (blocked)
components.description: The docs' signature: one frame of a run on a 1px rail. The blocked row carries a flat tint and says "Waiting on you" in words.
components.html:
1. tool_startIt calls write_file.
  2. approval_requiredWaiting on you The call is gated by a manifest rule. The run waits.
components.css: .ds-trace { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font:400 .875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d2cdc8); } .ds-trace li { --hue:var(--felix-state-running, #74d4ff); display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5rem 11rem 1fr; gap:0 .75rem; align-items:baseline; padding:.4rem .75rem .4rem 0; } .ds-trace .ds-blocked { --hue:var(--felix-state-blocked, #ffd230); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 7%, var(--sl-color-black, #1b1816)); border-radius:6px; } .ds-dot { justify-self:center; align-self:center; width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--hue); } .ds-trace code { font:400 .875rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); background:none; } .ds-trace strong { color:var(--hue); margin-right:.5ch; }

components.name: Route Index Row
components.description: One route: verb and path in mono, the spec's summary, and where it is explained. Hairline-separated.
components.css: .ds-routes { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font:400 .875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-routes li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,22rem) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,9rem); gap:.25rem 1rem; align-items:baseline; padding:.45rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, #292623); } .ds-routes code { font:400 .875rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); background:none; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-routes code span { display:inline-block; min-width:3.25rem; color:var(--sl-color-gray-3, #aaa39c); } .ds-sum { color:var(--sl-color-gray-2, #d2cdc8); } .ds-routes a { color:var(--sl-color-white, #fefdfc); text-underline-offset:.2em; }

narrative.overview: The manual that ships with the instrument. chat-ui is the Workbench; the docs are the same machine written down, for the moments the operator is not at the bench. The material is the Workbench's — since 2026-10-10 chat-ui's warm stone and charcoal, and its Geist and JetBrains Mono — hue still means state, and the page shows the mechanism: real event names, routes and error reasons.
keyCharacteristics: A warm neutral field — stone and paper in light, charcoal in dark — with no hue in it; dark is the default.
Geist for prose and UI, JetBrains Mono for code: chat-ui's faces, self-hosted.
Hue only from the four-state ramp, only where there is something to do or know.
One 48rem column for everything; tables and code scroll inside it when wider.
The mechanism drawn as data: RunTrace on the home page, events as a stacked list.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; no shadow authored anywhere in the docs' own CSS.

rules.name: The State-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only from the ramp, and only where the reader has something to do or know. A note is information, not a state, so notes are neutral; they used to draw in "running", the live colour, on text that was neither.

rules.name: The Flat-Mix Rule
rules.body: A tint is mixed into the page colour (color-mix(in srgb, hue 6%, --sl-color-black)), never laid on as an alpha, so a callout is one flat colour whatever sits behind it.

rules.name: The Route-Heading Rule
rules.body: A heading that is a route is set in the code face without the inline-code chip; at heading size the chip was a slab heavier than every prose heading beside it.

rules.name: The One-Edge Rule
rules.body: Prose and data share one column and one right edge. Never widen the column to fit a table: a table or code line wider than 48rem scrolls inside its own box.

rules.name: The Whole-Token Rule
rules.body: Code is never broken mid-token. Tables stack on a phone; routes in headings and code in table cells break only between segments.

dos: Do keep everything on the one 48rem column; let wide tables and code scroll inside it.
Do take hue only from the state ramp, and only where there is something to do or know.
Do mix tints into the page colour (color-mix(…, --sl-color-black)), never alpha them.
Do separate with 1px hairlines and tonal steps.
Do show real names: event types, routes and error reasons exactly as the harness sends them, with the source they were read from.
Do end a page on where to go next.
donts: Don't break code mid-token to make a table fit; scroll it or restack it.
Don't draw a coloured border thicker than 1px, or a callout with a thick left rule.
Don't use caution for a version note, or hue for a plain note.
Don't hand-edit src/styles/theme.css; change packages/design/src/tokens.ts and run pnpm sync:theme.

Don't introduce text fainter than faint-text (4.79:1 on the light stone) or smaller than 13px. The one exception is Scalar's method badges in the explorer sidebar, raised from 10px to 11px, chat-ui's own floor for text — its element, sized for its box, so only its size is overridden.
Don't author a shadow; Starlight's and Scalar's are incumbent, not a pattern.
